newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia paramilitary units fight rebels, four die.
newsitem.headline: Colombia paramilitary units fight rebels, four die.

text.p: Three men and a woman were killed when right-wing paramilitary fighters clashed with leftist guerrillas in northern Colombia on Monday, a police spokesman said.
The battle took place in a cattle-ranching area near San Martin in Cesar province, the spokesman in the provincial capital of Valledupar said.
"The combat was between two illegal groups. Three men died on the spot. The woman was taken to hospital with severe head wounds. It seems she died later," the spokesman said.
Some of those killed were wearing army-style camouflage uniforms, he said.

Paramilitary death squads have intensified their activities across northern Colombia in the last six months. But direct clashes with guerrilla groups are rare as the paramilitary units focus mainly on killing civilians suspected of supporting the rebels.
